title: Broker Intelligence Profile
description: Schema for explicit broker/trade intelligence profile context used as personalization input, not as a runtime user database model.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this broker_profile payload.

profile_id.description: Stable identifier for this explicit profile context.

role.description: Trade intelligence role represented by this profile context.

country_scope.description: Country or regional codes explicitly covered by this profile context.

jurisdiction_scope.description: Human-readable jurisdictions explicitly covered by this profile context.

nationality_or_operating_country.description: Optional operating country label when relevant to context framing.

commodity_specializations.description: Explicit commodity specializations used for profile-aware framing.

product_verticals.description: Explicit product verticals used for profile-aware framing.

regulatory_specializations.description: Explicit regulatory specializations used for profile-aware framing.

topics_of_interest.description: Explicit topics of interest available for later relevance assessment.

preferred_information_style.description: Preferred information framing style for future presentation layers.

detail_level.description: Preferred level of detail for future output framing.

language.description: Preferred language tag for future output framing.

risk_tolerance.description: Risk tolerance used for framing and human-review routing expectations.

human_review_preferences.description: Explicit human-review routing preferences for profile-aware outputs.

always_review_medium_or_higher_risk.description: Whether medium-or-higher risk outputs should always route to human review.

include_uncertainty_notes.description: Whether future outputs should include explicit uncertainty notes.

require_source_traceability.description: Whether profile-aware outputs should preserve source traceability.

escalate_regulatory_ambiguity.description: Whether ambiguous regulatory interpretations should be escalated to human review.

client_types.description: Optional explicitly provided client type context.

complexity_level.description: Optional complexity level for the profile context.

alert_frequency.description: Optional preferred alert frequency for future alerting layers.

notes.description: Optional bounded notes for profile curation context.

limitations.description: Optional bounded limitations for safe personalization usage.

source_refs.description: Optional local or reviewed references supporting this profile context. URLs and credentials are not part of this contract.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this profile context was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this profile context was last updated.
